name: Unitas
oneLiner: USDU is Unitas's delta-neutral synthetic dollar; direct USDC mint/redeem is whitelist-restricted, while most users acquire USDu on secondary markets.
collateral: Live Accountable reserves split across Binance off-exchange/perp margin and on-chain Solana/BSC reserves; ~10% of protocol fees route to an Insurance Fund
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized, delta-neutral: long JLP + short perpetuals rebalanced via Copper/Ceffu off-exchange settlement; direct mint/redeem against USDC is restricted to whitelisted participants on Solana and BSC, while retail access is primarily secondary-market.

oracleRisk.summary: USDu is issued against a protocol-managed delta-neutral reserve portfolio rather than borrower debt positions with oracle-triggered collateral liquidation.

branchApplicability.rationale: Unitas documents whitelist-restricted minting and redemption against deposited USDC, followed by protocol-managed allocation into JLP and hedged perpetual positions. It does not document borrower-specific debt, collateral-ratio thresholds, or liquidatable collateral branches for USDu issuance.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Unitas's Terms of Service reserve the right to freeze, burn, or otherwise restrict USDu and sUSDu under a user's control for legal or terms violations, while the same terms describe the tokens as issued through open-source contracts and state that Unipay cannot unilaterally modify user balances. This is a material issuer/operational restriction signal, but it does not by itself prove a live token-level blacklist or freeze function across the BNB and Solana deployments. The inherited status is retained for the documented centralized operational rails and the unresolved contract-level boundary.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: USDU BSC token is owned by a Gnosis Safe 3-of-5 (all EOA signers, no modules, v1.4.1) that can call mint(); the Solana Token-2022 mint has its mintAuthority set to the mint address itself — a self-referential pattern that prevents standard key-based verification.

controls.label: USDU BSC owner — Gnosis Safe 3-of-5
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103620388: token owner() = 0x8e3811b4…; getOwners() returned 5 EOA addresses (all eth_getCode=0x), threshold()=3, getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules), guard slot 6 = 0x0 (no guard), VERSION()='1.4.1'. BSC token is Ownable (non-upgradeable, mint() is onlyOwner) so the Safe is the sole on-chain minter on BSC.

controls.label: USDU Solana mint authority
controls.evidence: Solana Token-2022 mint 9ckR7pPP…: mintAuthority = the mint address itself (self-referential). Extensions present: metadataPointer and tokenMetadata (updateAuthority also = mint address). No freezeAuthority. Supply = 10,951,433 USDU. This pattern cannot be verified via standard key-based authority reads — the controlling program or keypair is unknown from on-chain state alone. Judgment per the moveUSD precedent: a self-referential Token-2022 mintAuthority (the mint address itself) is a non-executable, non-signing account, so no party can invoke MintTo on Solana; the Solana supply is effectively frozen.

sources.label: Accountable independent USDU proof of solvency

review.evidence: BSC block 103620388: Safe 3-of-5 (all EOA signers, no modules/guard, v1.4.1) confirmed as token owner with mint() = onlyOwner. Solana: Token-2022 mintAuthority = mint address itself (9ckR7pPP…), a self-referential configuration that cannot be verified as a standard keypair or program authority via on-chain reads. Promotion judgment: BSC mint surface fully confirmed (3-of-5 Safe, no modules); the Solana mintAuthority is self-referential and therefore unusable (moveUSD precedent), leaving no unconfirmed mint-capable surface. Accountable independently reconciles USDU backing assets to token liabilities. The public proof-of-solvency page advertises a 15-minute interval but showed reserve data last updated 2026-06-07, with its proof signature validated 2026-07-07; the observed evidence therefore supports periodic, not continuous, reconciliation. No registry evidence established prudential reserve supervision.
review.reviewer: Claude Phase 0c continuation; SOL-V mint-tier review

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDU has independent native deployments on Solana and BSC, each minted/redeemed against USDC by whitelisted participants on that chain with no live cross-chain supply route between them. The BSC token is a plain BEP20 (Safe-controlled mint, no OFT/LayerZero interface) and the Solana Token-2022 mint is self-referential/effectively frozen. A LayerZero cross-chain USDU route is roadmapped (ETA Q4 2025, "Design" phase) but not yet live, so the durable mechanism today is native per-chain issuance, not a bridge.

sources.label: Unitas backing, custody, and security overview

reserveReview.rationale: Accountable's dated proof-of-solvency snapshot verifies aggregate assets and liabilities but does not expose a current asset- or venue-level reserve split. Unitas documents an on-chain collateral layer plus off-exchange perpetual hedges and names Copper/Ceffu as example custody routes, but the reviewed issuer pages do not publish current weights. The prior fixed Binance/Solana/BSC percentages are therefore replaced with one unresolved strategy basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable aggregate solvency snapshot and Unitas's complete documented strategy envelope; current constituent weights undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current collateral assets, chain and venue weights, long and short notionals, hedge counterparties, margin, custody-provider shares, and insurance-fund balances are not exposed in the reviewed dated snapshot.
